steps.content: Hecate hides in the blind spot of the FAC outpost. Samuel is guarding a small communicator. After a while, a wave of radio noise comes out of it, followed by Donald's voice.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Phew... Now that's better! I was too busy running for my life just now to relieve myself.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's my first time inside an FAC stronghold. It's impressive, but ever thought of upgrading the toilets? Compared to the Executive Committee, the facilities here are a bit rudimentary.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: I apologize for any inconvenience. You see, we've poured all our budget into equipping the anti-Black Ring system. We appreciate your constructive feedback on our work.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Oh, you flatter me. I'm the one here to learn, after all! Let's first take a look at the Black Ring's data, shall we?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Of course, this way please.
Compared to a regular FAC soldier, Donald does come off as an overly dramatic madman. But at least he manages to retrieve the communicator hidden in the restroom.
The old man snuck this communicator into the construction team of the stronghold as early as the campaign in August, allowing it to bypass the subsequent rigorous security checks by the FAC.
[Scene Change] Inside the Command (Flora - FAC Base Background)
In the dimly lit war room, the stronghold's representative is showing Donald various complex charts, explaining them painstakingly as if he fears Donald can't read them.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: It's highly consistent with the BR-002 that erupted in Inner Bay's Mine W-31 in N.F. 104. Based on the Drifter Camp Black Ring Operation Report sent by the MBCC's Chief in March, we can confirm it's the same Corpseborne. In other words, this is the revival of the same Black Ring.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: But the Corpseborne in N.F. 104 was activated by the collective consciousness within the mine. After its destruction, the core of the Black Ring that was revived in N.F. 113 changed. Corpus 002 has merged with Julien, the leader of Rustfire, and became a new Corpseborne that's more powerful and unified.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hmm, I still recall how our great Paradeisos announced it...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: "Julien is not a Sinner, but the Undergrounders did something to him and turned him into a Black Ring, or rather, the anchor point of Rustfire's collective consciousness nine years ago."

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Exactly. BR-002 was already highly hazardous at its first appearance. We thought it was successfully suppressed at the time, but it turns out that Corpseborne 002 survived and even gained a powerful camouflaging ability. No one, not even the Undergrounders or Paradeisos, can confirm its whereabouts.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: This year, after the Drifter Camp Mania crisis in mid-March, the Rustfire uprising in West District in late March, and the abnormal spread of the shackles during the uprising, BR-002 had already grown larger than any Secondary Black Ring when it erupted again.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: A large number of shackle bearers instantly turned into Corruptors, and Mania spread rapidly in West District. If it weren't for the timely reinforcement of the Rust isolation belt, it would have threatened the entire city-state. That's why the FAC spared no effort to advance the August blockade campaign and build this defense line.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: But following the construction of the defense line, the data confirmed that BR-002 was exhibiting many inexplicable anomalies. Most conspicuously, as the Black Ring with the highest recorded M-value, BR-002 itself has never expanded. It...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Alright, alright. Let's get straight to the point. I already know all about this bizarre Black Ring. Tell me, what exactly is holding it off, and who exactly is buying precious time for humanity?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...Yes. As you may know, we have the MBCC's Chief ${PlayerName} who went missing during the uprising to thank. He risked his life to win us this opportunity.
steps.female_content: ...Yes. As you may know, we have the MBCC's Chief ${PlayerName} who went missing during the uprising to thank. She risked her life to win us this opportunity.

steps.content: (Scene change)

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: In the only preserved observation report from Paradeisos, it was mentioned that during his desperate battle with Corpus 002, he tried to link the shackles to the Corpus, possibly for location-tracking purpose.
steps.female_content: In the only preserved observation report from Paradeisos, it was mentioned that during her desperate battle with Corpus 002, she tried to link the shackles to the Corpus, possibly for location-tracking purpose.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Afterward, ${PlayerName} was ambushed by the rioters and disappeared. The shackles were seized and became a tool for Corpus 002 to contaminate the rioters. But in turn, they're also desperately suppressing the expansion of the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: We want to believe that ${PlayerName} is still fighting. As long as we can find him, or help him regain consciousness by suppressing the Corpseborne, then we have the possibility of defeating this Black Ring.
steps.female_content: We want to believe that ${PlayerName} is still fighting. As long as we can find her, or help her regain consciousness by suppressing the Corpseborne, then we have the possibility of defeating this Black Ring.

steps.content: Hecate's body starts to tremble slightly.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Is it real? Chief hasn't given up...

She has heard countless rumors about ${PlayerName}'s whereabouts. Alive, dead, turned into a monster, escaped from Paradeisos... They all sound absurd, suspicious, and even fabricated with ulterior motives.
This is the first time she's got a credible update, and it's so reassuring to hear it from the FAC.
(Scene change)
Donald claps his hands with satisfaction. The message has been delivered as intended. Hopefully, this will bring that kid some relief.
Now, let's get down to business.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I assume you guys called for me because there's a change in the situation?
The officer nods.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: BR-002 is attempting to break through its restraints. Since November, the contamination radiation has been growing more rapidly. Despite being limited by its physical boundary, it emits a large amount of contamination which spills out to form a massive contamination belt. So far, it has expanded to less than 300 meters from the inner edge of the defense line.
Donald looks at the M-value chart. Indeed, a ring of concentrated contamination has formed around the Black Ring, with some coordinates showing noticeably abnormal values.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The Underground has made a new breakthrough. According to the intelligence the 9th Agency has retrieved from a fatal mission, someone within the Mania forces has mastered a new type of sorcery. It was activated in November and has been continuously injecting Mania contamination into BR-002.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Even more despicably, unable to break through the FAC's defense, the Underground has been using infected civilians to attack the base, trying to create a breach. They've likely already infiltrated the blockade circle, laying down sorcery inside to tear down the constraints on BR-002.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Well, well, I smell another showdown between you guys and your arch-enemy. Syndicate sure is the perfect battlefield.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: That's why our speedy victory is crucial to the safety of West District. This special operation aims to enter the blockade circle and locate the sorcerer, eliminating both him and all his Mania sorcery.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Then why not just go ahead? What do you need me for? You don't think I can fight them, do you?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Look, I'm really not a fighter. I don't even have any special abilities. I'm counting on you to protect me, buddy!
A clerk standing next to them glances at him with a strange look but doesn't say anything. The officer continues.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The FAC will certainly be at the forefront, eliminating all threats. But that's supposing we can locate the enemy quickly and get to the battlefield where we need to be.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Please take a look at this picture.
[Image] Maze outside the Ring

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: What's this? The interior of the Black Ring?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: No, the cost of entering the Black Ring is high, and we haven't received instructions to enter it yet. This was taken on the contamination belt outside the ring. A material product of the leaked Mania contamination.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Such contamination has formed unusually complex paths and structures, and even mechanisms. Corruptors also run rampant in it... Yes, it's like a gigantic maze that keeps growing, blocking all intruders and protecting BR-002.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: I remember you said that Julien, the leader of Rustfire, was an outstanding architect before becoming a Corpseborne. Mechanism and maze are his expertise, and the Drifter Camp was his creation.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: That's right. I recognize these mechanisms. All the mazes and paths were his designs and signatures. They made up the fortress that Rustfire relied on for survival all along.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: This is why you're looking for someone who knows Rustfire inside out and can guide you through the architect's maze.
He looks around, and everyone else in the room is staring back at him.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: That's right. The interior of BR-002 is expanding rapidly. Even the MBCC has sent a warning that the contamination inside the Sinners shackled by ${PlayerName} is surging abnormally.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The shackles are weakening while BR-002, or rather Julien the Corpseborne, is growing more powerful. As the maze expands, more and more Corruptors become active outside the ring, and they will inevitably cross the boundary. West District can't withstand another catastrophe like that.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The city-state is already taking action. The 9th Agency has made its sacrifices. The FAC will take over the intelligence they've retrieved and enter the maze to eliminate the enemies and contain the contamination. Paradeisos has also deployed a special force to find ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Regardless of Rustfire's original intentions, nine years later, both itself and its leader have become actual threats to West District. Please help us do the right thing.
Listening, Donald nods, and then shrugs.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Well, I don't feel guilty or anything. To tell you the truth, I'm a traitor of Rustfire. I mean, at the end of the day, everyone must act in their own best interest.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Ever since I came onboard, the Executive Committee has been relying on me whenever they need to tackle the Drifter Camp. The maze and the mechanisms are a piece of cake. I'm happy to serve you.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: But there's one thing I don't understand... The 9th Agency is chasing the Underground, the FAC is guarding the Black Ring, and even Paradeisos is out looking for the shackles. It's looking like a big showdown against the evil.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Then what is our dear Executive Committee doing? The census, governance, and resettlement... It's all laborious work that doesn't matter.
He's staring at the stronghold's representative in front of him while surveying every person present in the room, capturing the subtle changes in their expressions.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I trust Paradeisos's decision. This arrangement must have a deeper meaning behind it... Do you know anything about it?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: I'm not sure I'm following. We don't know what's going on within the Executive Committee. The FAC's only goal is to subdue the Black Ring and protect the city-state. As for Paradeisos's decision, shouldn't you know better than we do?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Rumor has it that you were only able to transfer to the Executive Committee last year because an influential figure in Paradeisos vouched for you... Hush X, right?
Donald's face dims, but only for a split second. Abruptly, he throws his head back and bursts into hysterical laughter.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hahaha, what Hush, Shush, X, Y, Z? Some Paradeisian bigwig is watching over me? That sure sounds reassuring! In that case, I'm ready to go, since you all should be risking your lives to protect me!
He straightens his collar and struts out of the war room, whistling a tune loudly.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Whistle~
Samuel listens attentively. This is a code.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: ...Path confirmed. Hecate, follow me.
Wendy
Hecate doesn't follow immediately.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'm here to find Chief. Why would participating in the FAC's operation against the Underground help? Where is Chief?

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: ...Wherever your Chief is, he's been heavily corrupted and is now unconscious. If you want to save him, you need to drain the Mania out of him.
steps.female_content: ...Wherever your Chief is, she's been heavily corrupted and is now unconscious. If you want to save her, you need to drain the Mania out of her.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Only the Underground owns this kind of Mania-controlling technology, and its owner is in this maze. Donald will lure the FAC into holding back the enemies and our ally will help steal what we need.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Our job is to go to the rendezvous point to pick up the item and leave without alerting anyone or starting any fight. If successful, you can save your Chief. This is the only way.
He takes out several anti-Mania injections and hands them to Hecate.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Take these. The maze is severely contaminated. If you want to save your Chief, first, protect yourself.
[Scene change] Inside the Maze

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Alright, once in the blockade circle, regular communication will be severely disrupted. Please stay close to us, Mr. Donald.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: No worries, sir! Do what y'all are best at. I'll make sure I stay firmly behind you!
He squats in a corner of the maze and fires a few shots into the sky. He specifically changed his clothes before coming, saying he was itching for a good fight in a handsome outfit.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Charge, brave soldiers! I'll show you the way! Advance!
Turns out, it was still nothing but a bluff.
